correctness.rationale: For iid circular gaps Dirichlet(1,1,1), an angle reaches 120° iff its opposite arc gap is at least 4π/3. The three disjoint events have total probability 1/3, giving Q=0 atom. In the improving region, Fermat–Torricelli formula S²=p²+r²-pr cos A+√3 pr sin A yields q(s,α)=1−√[1−2H(s,α)(1−cos s)], where s=2π/3−A>0. Uniform interior expansion q≈h(α)s²/2 and the correct 3/π² gap-space Jacobian give P(0<Q<t)∼(3/π²)√t∫√[2/h]dα. The h endpoint poles are integrable; the proof bounds configurations near endpoints and s separated from zero as o(√t), then density change s→q/t and endpoint tightness justify total-variation convergence of mark law g(α)·Beta(1/2,1) with an independent uniform largest-gap label. Exact finite probability integral uses correct intersection limits for s,α. Separate quadrature reproduces C=2.700948948484718.
